sourceSentences: Catching the boomerang while it is returning back refunds 40% of the ability's total cooldown.
The boomerang return direction is determined at the apex of its flight by Gnar's current position and which direction Gnar is heading at the time.
Since the cooldown between the two is shared, Mini Gnar may pick up a boulder and/or Mega Gnar may catch a boomerang.
After 0.3 seconds, Gnar can pick up the boulder by moving within 90 units of it, refunding 70% of the ability's total cooldown.
The Boulder will still drop to the ground if colliding with Wind Wall or Unbreakable.

At maximum Rage, Gnar's abilities switch to Mega abilities, for 4 seconds and until transforming back to his Mini Gnar form, with the exception of Hop and Crunch, which switches after the transformation.
Casting any of them during this time also causes Gnar to transform into Mega Gnar instantly, else he will transform automatically after the 4 seconds have elapsed.
Afterwards, Gnar returns to Mini Gnar, retaining his current percentage health and becoming too tired to generate Rage for 15 seconds.
Gnar gains Hyper's bonus movement speed when he leaves Mega Gnar form.
Boomerang Throw can be cast during the dash.
If Gnar generates Rage to maximum during Hop, he may cast Boulder Toss, Wallop, or GNAR! during the bounce.
Gnar will not bounce if he is immobilized during the first leap.
Hop has no minimum dash range. Hop does not allow Gnar to bounce off wards.
knocking away nearby enemies up to 590 units in that direction, though not through terrain
Enemies that collide with terrain take increased damage immediately and are stunned instantly instead of slowed after a delay.
GNAR! can interact with player-generated terrain.
For combos, as Minina, attack twice into Q, making sure to catch it.
And your team fighting combo is to attack and Q away until your rage is full. Then use E to jump in into an attack, Q, W, and ult before attacking away.
Use your double jump to become mega, easily getting on their backlines before stunning and smashing everyone with tons of AoE damage.
j'ai mis mon Z pendant le rebond du du saut.
quand vous faites un E qui rebondit à ce moment-là, vous pouvez du coup lancer votre Z ou votre R au moment du deuxième dash.
Et vous pouvez mettre votre R au vol d'ailleurs qui va toucher la cible sur laquelle vous avez rebondi.
Attention, si vous faites un E qui n'est pas un rebond, ça marchera pas. Faut vraiment rebondir sur quelque chose.
le Q vers l'arrière a une box qui est méga longue, elle peut vraiment aller toucher quelqu'un dont vous connaissez la position mais qui est beaucoup trop loin.
Donc d'abord vous arrêtez de bouger, vous mettez votre Q et quand il commence à revenir vers vous, là seulement vous pouvez bouger.
Ce que vous pouvez faire tout simplement avec Gnar pour cacher l'animation du Q spell, c'est le mettre pendant un jump.
Un truc encore mieux, c'est carrément de faire un jump sur sur une cible. Hop, vous mettez EQ.
The first combo is the auto Q auto combo. It's important you always auto attack first before you hit your Q for more damage. This combo allows you to proc your W also very easily.
The third combo is E, auto W, auto Q, auto R. This one is the best alling combo for NAR with maximum damage in mind.
It's important you always auto attack between each ability for more damage and so you don't stack up the stuns too quickly.
If you're about to transform with Nar, you can jump towards enemies and hit your ultimate in the middle of the air.
